reason: All 6 acceptance criteria met and all 12 commands pass for the right reason (one documented command, tools/check-reference-contracts.py, runs 114 checks in covered/failed/unavailable buckets with exit 0/1/2 against the real reference sources: the C side compiled from the reference's own headers for thumbv7em-none-eabihf and read out of the object's .probe section, never executed; the Rust side parsed from hal/ and firmware/ source; the linker side parsed from link.x and layout.ld; 114 COVERED / 0 FAILED / 0 UNAVAILABLE; tools/test-reference-contracts.py proves 6/6 negative cases exit nonzero for the named reason, including that pixel-check.py's exit-0 SKIP becomes a nonzero UNAVAILABLE). DEGRADED because one CONFIRMED finding is open and close-out may not edit source: tools/check-reference-contracts.py:726 and :817 read the cold-snap side with a silent 0 default (rs.get('BURN_LEN_MAX', 0), rs.get('PSRAM_STAGE_OFFSET', 0) + rs.get('PSRAM_STAGE_LEN', 0)), so a missing or renamed constant reports COVERED instead of the drift signal the checker's own docstring at :186-188 promises. Weak guard, not a wrong result - all three constants exist and every value agrees today. One-character fix per site. Breaks no acceptance criterion.
open_confirmed: tools/check-reference-contracts.py:726 and :817 - two of the 114 checks read the cold-snap side with a silent 0 default, so an absent constant satisfies the bound unconditionally and reports COVERED rather than FAILED; reproduced by replaying both call sites with rs={} against this run's real probe values. PSRAM_STAGE_OFFSET (hal/src/psram.rs:194) is consumed only at :817, so its rename is caught nowhere; BURN_LEN_MAX is still caught at :834 and PSRAM_STAGE_LEN at :827. Contradicts the checker's documented contract at :186-188 and the prompt Objective 'Make source drift fail visibly'. Drop the ', 0' at both sites. Breaks no acceptance criterion.
